items.headline: IEA chief says market forces will keep the clean‑energy transition moving despite stalled climate talks
items.summary: Even though international negotiations faltered, Fatih Birol argues that data‑center demand, energy security concerns and private investment are enough to sustain the shift toward electricity and renewables. The message signals to policymakers that the momentum toward decarbonisation is largely self‑propelling.
